name: Okasare Yuusha IV ~Mou Dame. Boku no Ochinchin wa Genkai na no ni~
original_name: 犯され勇者Ⅳ ～もうダメっ。ボクのおちんちんは限界なのにぃ～
source:
A world under invasion by monster girls.
You vow to liberate the people from fear, but the endless monsters and the demon lord are too powerful for a mere human.

In your travels you meet a succubus who can help you
gain strength and recruit monsters girls to the side of good. Of course, you can still fail... and if you do... A hell of creative, sexy enemies are waiting to reverse r*pe you!!

[Slightly edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE127132.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这是一个被怪物娘入侵的世界。
你发誓要把人们从恐惧中解放出来，但无尽的怪物和魔王对普通人来说过于强大。

旅途中，你遇见了一名能够帮助你获得力量的魅魔，并可以招募怪物娘加入正义一方。当然，你也可能失败……而一旦失败……等待你的将是专门为逆转强奸而设计的地狱般、富有创意的色情敌人！！
